name: Machine service
purpose: Leases machines to AI agents through one HTTP API: GET /machines lists them, POST /acquire leases one, exec/push/pull work inside the lease, and release ends it. This Mac also offers disposable Tart virtual machines: a lease clones a golden base (macOS 26 or Ubuntu 24.04), boots it headless over NAT and destroys it at release; at most 2 macOS guests run at once.
